newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia bank agrees 105 mln marks loan with EBRD.
newsitem.headline: Croatia bank agrees 105 mln marks loan with EBRD.

text.p: Croatia's Bank for Reconstruction and Development (HBOR) said on Thursday it agreed a 105 million German marks loan with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD).
HBOR is a government investment bank. It said in a statement faxed to Reuters the loan would be used to finance local infrastructure and environmental projects in the coastal region of Dalmatia.
The agreement will be signed on December 9 in the county seat, Split. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
